release_status: prepared for 0.4.0 release; publication and portable-platform checks remain release gates

getting-started.focus: Readiness, installation/update boundaries, hardware-aware setup, SSH identity and diagnostics.

cli.focus: Command paths/options via isolated Click parsing; lifecycle, defaults and cross-links.

clusters.focus: Hardware placement, observed status, executor destinations, reservations and cache policy.

runtimes.focus: Runtime declarations and image defaults, memory policy, readiness/cache applicability; Atlas multi-node validation.

advanced.focus: Managed plugins, daemon lifecycle/security and workload management, model-cache usage/pins/claims and optional LRU cleanup, model transfers, runtime caches, and feature gates.

developer-reference.focus: Public API imports/options, initialization and lazy installed integration, extension execution/feedback/benchmark contracts, current source layout. Daemon routes, complete operation argument inventory, result/error contracts, manager identity, and framework-free extension declarations. Expanded plugin authoring coverage: catalogs, CLI commands/options, recipe keys/formats, setup/hardware, execution families and strategies, distribution/gateway providers, benchmark hooks, workload lifecycle, configuration and rollback. Plugin loading policy and static manifests, lifecycle planning, bounded plugin diagnostics, shared capture, reusable log targets, native Kubernetes sources, daemon artifact downloads and result validation.

recipes.focus: Builder prepare contract, readiness and resource validation/selection, GGUF/projectors and registry trust.

claude-code-plugin.focus: Shipped command names/examples, current gateway selection and direct-CLI lifecycle.

tutorials.focus: End-to-end readiness, benchmark integrations/progress/resume, gateway installation/selection and placement.

landing.focus: Footer promotion/legal/community links, readiness/fit copy, historical demo label and responsive/theme behavior.

Installed fixtures verify lazy/console-free initialization, command callbacks with a stubbed host probe, registry and recipe behavior, benchmark/setup/runtime contracts, literal manifests, lifecycle plan idempotence, plugin diagnostic ownership/redaction, disabled builders, nested capture, and closed reporters. Network and subprocess calls remain denied.
